subject: gk
question: CSIR as an autonomous body is the largest research and development organisation in India. What does CSIR stands for?

options.text: Chamber of States and Industrial Research
Centre of Space and Industrial Research
Council of Space and Industrial Research
Council of Scientific and Industrial Research

solution:
The correct answer is __**Council of Scientific and Industrial Research**__.

__
 
• **The Council of Scientific and Industrial Research abbreviated as CSIR** was established as an autonomous body in **September 1942** by the Government of India as the largest research and development organization in India. emerged from.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **CSIR:**

 
 
• Parent institution - Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India
 
• Founder(s) - **Arcot Ramaswamy Mudaliar and Shanti Swaroop Bhatnagar**
 
• Established - 26 September 1942
 
• President - Prime Minister of India
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Some other organisations:**

 
 
• Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO)
 
• Defence Research and Development Organization (DRDO)
 
• Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)
 
• Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC)
 
• Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)
 
• Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR)
